Iran Strikes US Bases Amidst Growing Tensions and US Political Reactions

Iran launched drone attacks targeting bases hosting US forces in Kuwait and Iraq, in retaliation for a US strike that killed Iranian military commander Qasem Soleimani. The US has stated Iran was responsible for the attack on the tanker. President Trump described the conflict with Iran as "small potatoes" for the US and indicated readiness for potential Israeli strikes on Iran. Meanwhile, reports suggest Trump is considering Pentagon leadership changes due to frustration over the Iran conflict. The widow of an airman killed in the Middle East expressed upset over being told Iran was not a war while sorting out benefits.
